name: Barikanchi
world_status: a description exists but is not accessible

earlier_scan.note: Extinct Hausa-based pidgin; only Hodge 1960 'Non-native Hausa' and Ethnologue entries; no phonological description located.

sources.citation: APiCS Online (Michaelis et al. 2013), contributions list.
sources.note: No Hausa-lexifier pidgin is among the APiCS contributions (lexifier legend: Arabic, Bantu, Dutch, English, French, Malay, Portuguese, Spanish, Other); Barikanchi is not covered.

sources.citation: Lewis, M. Paul (ed.). 2009. Ethnologue: Languages of the World, 16th ed. Dallas: SIL International. Entry 'Barikanchi' (bxo).
sources.note: Nothing. Entire entry: 'A language of Nigeria. ISO 639-3: bxo. Population: No estimate available. Classification: Pidgin, Hausa based. Language use: Used in military barracks. Comments: Second language only.'

sources.citation: Wikipedia (en), 'Barikanchi pidgin', wikitext as of 2026-09-17 (cites Fiamingo 2000 p. 77; Hymes (ed.) 1971 p. 518; Osaji 1979; Ethnologue 25).
sources.note: Nothing; stub on sociolinguistic setting only (barracks lingua franca, 'hausan bariki', name from bariki 'barracks').

sources.citation: Glottolog 5.x languoid page bari1241 'Barikanchi' and pseudo-family haus1258 'Hausa-based pidgin'.
sources.note: Nothing. Descriptive refs for bari1241 are Ethnologue and Hodge 1960 only; haus1258 lists no references.
